Hello fellow Doll-citizens!


The soundtrack for Acidpunk: Echoes of Doll City has just been released!!! We've been waiting for this moment for a while now, and with the final version of the game getting closer, we think the time is right!

33 tracks, including unreleased ones, and a whole bunch of hours spent tweaking sounds that, I hope, fit the strange and hallucinatory atmosphere of the game. 

Long ambient and trippy passages mingle with synthwave, IDM, or eerie vocoder ballads, performed by fictional bands. Every tune has been produced with this question in mind: what kind of music a band or a musician would play if they were living in a place like Doll City? 

I hope you'll enjoy listening to it as much as I enjoyed making it.


Peace,


Aerosteak

notes.title: Major update ! 12/2023
notes.content:
Greetings fellow dollcitizens,

We're back after a long period of absence, during which we faced challenges that temporarily halted our project. Rest assured, it was never abandoned; we managed to rescue it from hiatus and are ready to dive back in. We sincerely appreciate your incredible patience and apologize wholeheartedly for the extended wait.

We're excited to announce a long-awaited update, featuring the release of the original soundtrack later this month and a playable demo coming your way in the next few days. For the current update, we've modernized the gaming system to align with the latest VR locomotion standards. We've introduced a more intuitive selection process, a new simpler and less restrictive tutorial (in beta), bug fixes, and significant overall optimization.

The new gameplay now includes lateral movements, and it will no longer be possible to move while controlling a bot, eliminating potential conflicts. Additionally, we've added a cinema room to enhance your experience.

Beyond these improvements, minor updates are in the pipeline to fine-tune certain aspects of the game. We want to assure you that the next major update won't keep you waiting for a year. Thank you for your ongoing support and understanding.

Best regards,
[Development Team]

notes.title: Major update on the way!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow dollcitizens!


We're finally back on tracks with a major update coming soon!
First, thanks for all your comments and constructive feedback. We've been scratching our heads to find the best way to bring Acidpunk: Echoes of Doll City to today's VR standards.

We have decided to remove some features in the control scheme to bring back a more straightforward and intuitive gameplay. This will also significantly improve performance for everyone. This will make it easier and quicker to integrate the remaining levels of the main story.
New immersive roomscale areas are being finalized. A new, shorter and simpler tutorial is also in the making. For those of you who followed the game since the beginning and missed the good old side scroller levels, you will be very pleased, as several ones will be integrated to the main game to take you further towards the end of this journey! 

To sum up: better and simpler controls, more intuitive gameplay and more levels. 

Stay tuned.

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: 06/24/2021 Major update
notes.content:
New skin for an old ceremony!

Doll City: Prologue changes its name to become ACIDPUNK: Echoes of Doll City!

Why did we take this decision?

First of all because we think it sounds great and secondly because we find that it fits much better with the atmosphere of the game. More importantly, the subtitle "Prologue" might have been misleading and would let players think they would only get the first part of a game series. ACIDPUNK is a complete game, and you will be able to live your adventure from beginning to end, no strings attached.

Here is a summary of what we've been working on for this update:
- Gameplay and controls optimization
- Faster loading times
- Increased overall stability
- Many bug fixes
- Graphics overhaul

[previewyoutube=R3NTWHAKBMo;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you will enjoy the work we have done so far. We will now focus on the next level of ACIDPUNK to bring you the conclusion of your fantastic journey to the twisted Doll City megalopolis.

Do not hesitate to give us your feedback and general thoughts about the game, thanks a lot for this!

Cheers,

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Focus on next update: #4 Soundtrack
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Dollcitizens!

From dark alleys to impressive landscapes, you will never walk alone in Doll City. Indeed, wherever you go, music will be omnipresent.

From ambient soundscapes to vibrant synthwave, the soundtrack also includes a large variety of genres: nostalgic ballads, psychedelic rock, dark vaporwave, haunting classical themes with hints of chiptune and metal... Your ears are in for a treat.

Each music has its own atmosphere and purpose, and has been created to fit perfectly with the scenery. Some hints about the main story can be hidden in vocoded lyrics, two themes might be playing at once and fit together like pieces of a puzzle, and parts of some levels can be lived like interactive music videos.

[previewyoutube=YRKPxON_oQw;full][/previewyoutube]

More than 30 tracks have been written to tell you everything about the madness and loneliness of the lost souls of Doll City. As we are getting closer to the final release, more sounds will be unveiled. 

We also plan to release the soundtrack later this year, both in Steam and digital music platforms, tell us in the comments if you are interested!

Cheers,

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Merry X-Mas!
notes.content:
We've got some news for you.
First, we'd like to thank you for your feedback on the game. Here is the current state of development and what's coming next.

The current sanitary crisis has somewhat disrupted the planned schedule, but we are making prgress and doing our best to improve the gameplay and the game overall.

We are currently in the process of finalizing the last levels of the game. The update of the old levels, the scenario, music, and sound design being almost completed, we are mainly focused on the gameplay and integration of the new elements.

Meanwhile, a new update should come very soon, mainly to fix the bugs that have been reported, and to give you a more stable version of the game so that you can get the most of the current experience.

Roomscale / gamepad versions:

Currently we are mainly working on the roomscale version. The gamepad version will be updated for the release of the game, which will allow you to approach the Dollcity universe from another point of view thanks to the 1st person and sidescroller gameplay.

In the meantime, here are some screenshots of the new levels playable in the final version, which, if all goes well, is scheduled for Q1 2021 (at last!). We are also planning some updates after release, with some free surprises along the way.

	- Acoustic & visual redesign of the turrets in order to fit better with rest of the universe.
	- Further gameplay improvements and optimizations (rotation, teleport…).
	- Correct controllers display position for Valve Index users.
	- Finalizing advanced tutorial.

For the final release:

	- Better and more intuitive use of AR Vision to display hidden messages & intel.
	- More advanced remote control of other bots using your integrated hacking device.
	- More AR Chips, complete story integration and new gameplay mechanics.
	- Integration of the Bonus Room.
	- Integration of the Museum.
	- New levels to guide you to the end of the story. 
	- Finalizing gamepad/seated mode (for old school gamers / people who discovered the game during the DK2 era).
	- Cyber drugs which will affect your vision. And your health… Winners can use drugs, but the right ones in a responsible way^^
	- More SFX & music, overall sound mixing & optimization.
	- Soundtrack & art book release.

Here are our ambitions with this project. We want you to have a psychedelic trip in an original cyberpunk universe, unlike anything you have seen or heard. You will have all the keys to understand the plot and uncover the mysteries of Doll City, and make this story yours.

Doll City isn’t and won’t be a FPS, even if you can encounter a few opponents on your way, they are not here to artificially raise the difficulty of the game. Many other things can kill you in this dreaded megalopolis…

Like in any exploration / adventure game, you will have to unblock paths, solve puzzles and finally discover what R’aid is looking for inside Project M’s data maze. 

We want to offer you something enjoyable, beautiful and most importantly bring you a different experience than anything you experienced in VR so far. 

Cheers,

Team InfiniVerse

notes.content:
Hello fellow Dollcitizens!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25860350/2ba4fc8aece89872cd9ee8e236cdff3c43d78283.jpg[/img]

Latest news from the InfiniVerse team about Doll City's progress. As you may know, we are a very small team: 2 developpers, a musician / sound designer and a story teller / translator.  We want to bring you a quality experience, an amazing journey in a psychedelic cyberpunk universe. Devil being in the details, we are working hard to make this this game as complete and unique as possible. Enough talk for now, let's get to the point: where is Doll City Prologue heading to?

For the time being, you can play the first 10 levels either in roomscale or seated mode. Each mode brings a totally different gameplay and visual experience. We strongly encourage you to play them both, they will show you two sides to Doll City's story.

Main differences

Roomscale mode (Vive controllers / Oculus Touch)

- locomotion systems: dash or trackpad (trackpad mode can be switched between tactile/sliding or pressing on HTC Vive)
- synergy gameplay: you can control another character from a distance on some levels
- multitask robotic hands avatar (flashlight / gun / toolkit...)
- unique interactions

Seated mode (xbox compatible gamepad)

- left stick locomotion, you can switch to dash or teleport if you are prone to motion sickness
- you can make our virtual body appear / disappear according to your preferences and comfort
- aiming with your head
- 3rd person control on some levels (sidescroller mode, teleport still possible)
-eclairage frontale

For both modes

- ingame menu with video options (a Geforce 970 is recommended for minimum settings, a 1070 brings you a superior graphic quality)
- go back easily to the main menu
- during early access, the first 10 levels are unlocked from the start. However, we strongly recommend to play them by chronological order to fully assimilate gameplay mechanics 

What's expected for 2018?

- lots of new sound FX, better ingame mixing and spatialization to bring a deeper immersion
- complete storytelling and definitive english translation
- new comic book pages
- 10 new levels full of surprises, both in roomscale and seated mode
- every known bug and glitch should be corrected after early access
- Steam achievements and trading cards
- Windows MR compatibility
- complete soundtrack available (around 20 original tunes) 
- a VR soundtrack (a totally new and radical experience, scheduled for shortly after the final game's main release). We'll give you more details in a little while!
- a complete story: you will finally know the truth about Doll City's darkest secrets!
- a bonus mode with many surprises, presented as a free roaming sector of the city with many places to visit (movie theater, museum, information booths and hidden secrets...)

Thank you all for your support, cheering comments and constructive criticism and see you very soon for a new major update!

Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Major update 2 - Oculus Touch support and more
notes.content:
Hello, fellow doll citizens!

We want to thank you for all your feedbacks. We haven't included all of your suggestions yet, but many have been taken in account with this update, and the other ones should be included in the next minor updates (see list at the end).

For this major update, we have included:

- The Oculus Touch support in roomscale is of course the big addition brought by this update. We know that you are a lot to have been waiting for it since a long time, and we want to thank you for your patience. We hope that you will have a lot of fun discovering Doll City in roomscale mode.


- New introductions in levels 1 and 3

- Correction of the roomscale menu on the return button on the graphics pannel

- Correction of the ingame menu for the trackpad locomotion speed

- Added: a switch to quickly choose between teleportation and trackpad

notes.title: New major update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow doll citizens!

Here is the first major update including new gameplay and levels both for gamepad and roomscale modes.

For now roomscale mode is only available for HTC Vive. But don't worry, Oculus Rift support should be relased soon, we're working on it. 

What's new:

- 10 levels for gamepad mode, for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift

- New gameplay for gamepad mode, with first person view and sidescroller third person view
- Several choices of locomotion: teleportation/dash/trackpad
- Items to pick up (access cards, boxes, hallucinogenic substances...) 
- Advanced interactions with the environnment
- A unique trip, in a universe where blurring the lines between reality, mind trips and virtuality
- New design for the comic book events
- New sounds and music (a lot remains to be included yet)
- New ingame menu
- A way to switch graphics quality/supersampling

The game immerses you in the story of a derelict megalopolis told through full-scale comic-book pages, with a soundtrack paying tribute to early 80s electronic music.

Welcome to this new update of Doll City, a one of a kind cyberpunk trip.


Team Infiniverse

notes.title: Doll City Beta is now available!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Doll-Citizens!


First thank you all for your patience! The long awaited beta is finally here, and you can access it using the beta branch of the game (properties --> BETA --> dollcitybeta). Of course, the game still being in beta, there will be probably some bugs left. We will spend the next days correcting every error that we can find. We will be checking the discussion boards daily so feel free to give us your feedback and comments!

Being a very small team (at first we were two developpers, a sound designer and a scriptwriter), we originally planned Doll City as a smaller VR side scroller project. But when we laid our greasy little hands on the HTC Vive and discovered roomscale, it blew our minds! This is why we kept improving the game mechanics and had to re-imagine everything to meet our expectations of what a VR game should be. We hired a third developper to help us and took the hard decision to delay the release of Doll City by a few month in order to offer you a complete and satisfying VR experience. 

We added a more complex gameplay, including infiltration and shooting. We also decided to create a much bigger environment, with some entire neighbourhoods ready for exploration. We also had to rewrite the main storyline to remain coherent with the game's universe and the new levels. More polished sounds and music have also been added (a lot are still waiting to be integrated though) and we began working on the overall mix.

Today you are going to get your first taste of these new features, and we hope you'll like it! The final version is getting closer evryday, and we can't wait for you to discover the whole story and many surprises of Doll City.

Again we want to thank you all for making videos or sharing your feedbacks with us. This really helped us improve the game.


Important information about this update:

- Doll City gets a new, more complex gameplay: infiltration.
- Right now, roomscale mode is only available for the HTC Vive. But we are working hard on bringing it to Oculus Touch as soon as possible.
- Seated mode can be played with HTC Vive, Oculus Rift or OSVR, with an old fashioned early 21st century gamepad. 
- The options menu is not available yet. It will be available in a short time.


What's next:

- New levels, which will lead you to the conclusion of the main story and uncover some dark secrets...
- New gameplay elements will make their appearance in the final version.
- To thank you for your patience, a free bonus mode will appear shortly after the final release. It will have a part of the city in free roaming mode, with new things to discover: minigames, musics, videos...

Cheers!

The InfiniVerse team

"With braiNet, off with connection or pain problems during cerebral connection attacks. braiNet contains all the painkillers you need for any ache. With braiNet, surf and die with all the softness you deserve."

"braiNet, better than your antivirus."

-I'm sorry. Anyway since we enlarged the universe -and for those who have already played the game, we promise a lot of things have changed- you won't recognize the game, and be reassured, nothing has been deleted, only improved and rearranged. -Yes, except in case of hacking of course, and this is why there is braiNet, but please continue.

-Ahem yes, remember in the bonus section, this tiny piece of city that was offered. Well, it has grown a lot... We lost 300 scan bots to recreate a part of Sector 3. Bloody gangers... And about the rest of the game, the third person phases are still here but with a new camera system that should be a lot more comfortable and less dangerous for your limbs.

-Well right now we are focusing on the last touches on the levels, and finishing the city. 100% of the data collected by the bots have been retrieved and our teams have already starting integrating the smell of the city and some other bonuses.

-Thank you! Our show is over, but you can see me again in one hour with SteelHand, the disposable bionic arms, with our guests, the creators of Dolly the... Beeeeeep.

notes.title: Hello fellow Doll citizens !
notes.content:
First, we would like to thank you warmly for buying the game while it's still in early access, it means a lot to us. Your comments, constructive criticism and videos help greatly in our process of improving the game until the final release.

Where are we now  ?

Well, at this stage of development, it's important to keep you informed about Doll City. We are a very small team (4 developers), and sometimes it's hard to keep up and answer every question, and english not being our primary language, communicating  on a regular basis isn't as easy as we'd like.  We plan to relase the final version before the end of 2016, and everything should go as planned.

Who's behind Doll City  ?

We are video game players and VR fan's, and we wanted our first game to include everything we appreciate in both VR and gaming. Of course, we don't have as much resources  as a major game company, but we've got experience, love and passion  ! We already spent countless hours developing the game, as we've got much more time than money (Valve or CD Projekt, if you can hear us and want to invest on a VR project, we're open to discussion!^^)

Ok, but what's the game about  ?

Different kinds of gameplay, with a nice replayability wether you choose to play first or third person. A handcrafted acidpunk universe in which the story unfolds through comic book pages (gotta catch them all!), and an original soundtrack for your hears only  !
As we stated before, we LOVE video games, and are well aware of the improvements Doll City needs to meet our quality criterias. We still need to work hard on gameplay elements, Shooter mode being reworked from scratch and constant improvement are made on the roomscale levels. Although we want the players to explore Doll City and take their time to unveil its darkest secrets, we also want the gameplay to be intuitive and easy to master by including tutorial levels and fine tuning the controls.  
Wether you will be using a gamepad or a Vive controller, the experience should be satisfying and highly responsive. An ingame menu is also in the works as well as a brand new level selection room.

What will change in the final version  ?

More levels and chapters, of course. Early access levels will also have lots of changes and improvements, and the storyline will be unveiled by inserting new chapters and cinematics. There will be a total of 20 chapters for each game mode, and also bonus areas and surprises  !
The experience will be drastically different if you choose to play with the gamepad or the Vive controllers. Third person mode will  be very different and intense, with new enemies and gameplay elements. A new camera mode is also in the works. First person will be more based on exploration, with the addition of the storyline and some puzzle elements.
The new tutorial levels will help new players prepare themselves to they journey into Doll City.

When will it be finally released, and what VR headsets will be supported  ?

We are planning a mid december release, for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and OSVR (as well as any forthcoming Steam VR compatible hmds).
The original soundtrack will also be available.
For a better experience we'd avise to have at least a GTX 970 GPU.

To sum up  : 

-Brand new menus (ingame, level select, video quality)
-Tutorial levels 
-Seated and roomscale modes
-20 seated levels
-20 motion controllers levels
-Some maps available in both roomscale and seated with the possibility to ---switch between points of view, changing drastically the experience.
-New bonus areas and surprises
-Complete narration and a proper english translation
-Cinematics 
-Non-VR mode (beta)
-OSVR full support
-Full music & sound design integration
-Checkpoints
-Cover points
-New enemies and AI
-New moves and weapons
-Choice between teleportation and first person movement for roomscale -levels
-And so much more  !


Team Infiniverse the future is now

notes.title: First update! Teleport mode & 4 bonus levels.
notes.content:
Hello and thanks again for supporting our project. We are a small team of 4 VR adventurers doing our best to bring you a beautiful and immersive VR experience.

First of all, we want to reassure you again: the game will support Vive controllers and roomscale, we will start bringing these features on the next update, due for release next weekend if everything goes as planned!
Anyway, we heard all your requests and feedback, and here is the first update:

  - A new teleportation system for seated mode (RB to teleport and LB to orient teleportation).

  - Added a room between levels 0 and 1 as a narrative arc (includes a video).

  - Some texts in levels 0 and 1 heve been fixed and now display properly.

  - Added 4 new rooms in the bonus part (including some rooms from the demo)

  - Fixed some bugs and rewrote some instructions.
Notes: 
  
- Teleportation is active for most levels but not for the platformer ones, as it would make them lose all interest. 

  - Roomscale version of these levels will have a teleportation system that doesn't break the platforming aspect.
Thanks again, and see you in the streets of Doll City!

Team : InfiniVerse
